description: Get the indicative foreign-exchange rates Checkout.com uses (e.g. for card payouts). Checkout.com: GET /forex/rates.

currency_pairs.description: Comma-separated currency pairs, e.g. 'GBPEUR,USDNOK' (required, up to 20 pairs).

processing_channel_id.description: Processing channel id ('pc_...') to scope the rates.

product.description: Product the rates are for, e.g. 'card_payouts'.

name: checkout_get_forex_rates
title: Get forex rates
